item.title: Automatically Delete Old Pa11y Results From MongoDB
item.description:
You’ve probably already noticed that Pa11y-Dashboard runs all the tasks on a daily basis. If you have a lot of tasks (e.g. 100+) then the test results can fairly quickly gobble up your MongoDB quota (if you have any).

If your MongoDB has a size limit defined, then you can do two things:

  • manually delete old test results
  • or use TTL Index to do it for you automagically

MongoDB supports TTL indexes since v2.2 (Aug 2012!). Such indexes make mongod automatically remove data after a specified number of seconds or at a specific clock time. Before we create one, please have a look at existing indexes for Pa11y test results collection:
